selectors: nearest Unity project root from CWD

request.rootRequestId: one UUID per direct public call
request.serialization: one immutable UTF-8 body without BOM
request.deadline: one absolute deadline frozen before lifecycle waiting
request.redelivery: a disconnected or timed-out direct call has no request-level recovery or replay guarantee; the caller decides whether to submit a new call

toolExecution.success: terminal business success proven by the tool's unique completion contract
toolExecution.failure: terminal structured failure with stable code, details and nextActions

ordinary.completion: one complete snapshot from one validated listener generation
ordinary.transitionPolicy: wait within the original absolute deadline, then rerun the complete read

editor.state.completion: one immediate read-only registry, Bridge and Windows observation

directCall.terminal: each direct call returns a proven terminal business result or terminal structured failure
directCall.timeout: timeout or disconnect returns E_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT; the caller decides whether and how to retry
directCall.replay: the system provides no request-level replay interception or outcome recovery
directCall.audit: audit is a session-level append log

compile.proof: owned CompilationPipeline cycle terminal, zero compiler errors, import/compile/reload stable and Editor ready
